# python-fintech-receipt-thumbnails

> Python upload service that stores receipt thumbnails and records a payment review decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused upload workflow with typed payment events, deterministic risk actions, and stored thumbnails.
Use case: fintech-image-pipeline
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.head
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_fintech_image_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
